Seven pieces of what looks like roasted potato or braised radish sit on a square plate about 26 cm across. Each piece is roughly 3–4 cm, about 15 g, so the serving totals about 110 g.

If it is potato with a little oil, that comes to about 120 kcal per 100 g. The pieces look somewhat translucent, though, which suggests daikon braised in soy sauce, and that would be much lower in energy.

As a compromise between the two, I estimate about 100 kcal.
